version.changelog: v2.3 quality enhancement - security audit + marketing packaging + slug-content validation

llm.summary: This skill is an image-generation workflow helper, but it asks for broad command/file authority and includes external sending and browser-session automation with loose scoping.

dimensions.detail: Read, write, and exec access are plausible for saving, converting, and organizing generated images, but the requested authority is broad and the documentation does not tightly limit commands, paths, browser profile use, or external destinations.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The package contains only artifact/SKILL.md and no executable installer, but the instructions reference Playwright, desktop-agent via uvx, Python scripts, ImageMagick, and browser automation as runtime dependencies.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Activation language includes broad productivity and workflow-optimization triggers, so an agent could select the skill for tasks outside image generation; the skill also includes scheduled and webhook-triggered workflow concepts without clear user confirmation boundaries.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No startup service, credential harvesting, or durable background persistence was found, but the skill describes scheduled execution, webhook triggers, use of a logged-in Grok browser session, and optional Feishu sending.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Grok image generation, batch export, post-processing, and optional Feishu distribution, which is coherent overall, but the artifact also advertises generic file processing, API integration, command execution, and information retrieval beyond image workflows.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review this skill before installing if you do not want broad local command/file access, browser automation against a logged-in Grok account, or generated images sent to Feishu or callbacks. Use it only with explicit output directories and confirmed messaging destinations, and avoid giving it unrelated automation tasks.
llm.findings:
[SDI-2] unexpected: The artifact-backed concern is valid: the duplicated core-function section advertises generic command execution, file handling, API integration, and information retrieval that are broader than Grok image generation.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad activation wording around efficiency, automation, batch processing, and workflow optimization is not tightly bound to image generation and could cause over-selection.
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad keyword coverage line repeats generic routing terms, reinforcing applicability outside the stated image-generation domain.
[SQP-2] expected: Sending generated images to Feishu is purpose-aligned and disclosed, but the artifact does not clearly explain privacy implications, destination confirmation, or opt-in controls for transmitting generated content to third-party messaging services.
